user.title: Connect to Jarvis
user.description: The address of a running jarvis-gateway, the bearer it holds for Home Assistant, and the language Jarvis uses for a new conversation.

data_description.url: The gateway's base URL, without a trailing slash or a path.
data_description.bearer: The value of JARVIS_GATEWAY_HA_BEARER on the gateway.
data_description.language: hu or en. Also the language of the lines Jarvis speaks when the gateway fails.

error.cannot_connect: The gateway did not answer as jarvis-gateway would.

data_description.language: hu or en. A conversation already running keeps its own language.
